note: Scores measure identification + portion error against database-computed truth. The totals below are food weight from a kitchen scale; nutrient truth uses the same database entries as the estimates, so database error is not part of the score.

scaleDisplay.summary: In meals 003 and 005 a scale display was visible in the test photo, showing ounces. The vision model read the display as grams ("60.81 oz" → "608.1", "59.54 oz" → "595.4") and anchored its estimate to the misread number — in 005 it additionally subtracted an assumed container weight. In meal 004 it read the display but rejected the value as implausible and estimated visually. Three photos, three different behaviors.

appRunReading.note: Left unconfirmed by the gate; it could not be logged.

samNotes: SAM 3.1 grounding (scored separately): dish-level and unit-level prompts ground reliably ("the bowl" 3/3 meals, "the tacos" → exactly 3 segments).
Filling-level prompts inside a bowl ("the meatballs", specific dish items) returned no segments in most attempts.
Prompts are kept to the simplest noun form first; items without a mask remain fully loggable (mask-less is a supported state).
